description: Future manual browser matrix; source and CI validation do not constitute live acceptance.

roles.DM: true DM account in normal tabletop

preflightGapsAtAudit: held torch and placed tool missing
second map not prepared with token fixture

scenarios.action: Join same active map in separate authenticated profiles.
mustObserve: Correct current map and server-authorized roster for each actor
No false first-load movement block

scenarios.action: Try to control a foreign token and verify concealed NPC is not accessible to player view.
mustObserve: Foreign movement is refused
No undisclosed NPC identity through player DOM, accessible assets or authorized API responses

scenarios.action: On first normal DM entry drag an owned or controllable token without entering preview.
mustObserve: Drag starts on first interaction
One approved commit; no terrain reload

scenarios.action: Each player drags own token on first entry.
mustObserve: Local drag begins immediately within certified path
Final position is authorized and observed by all

scenarios.action: Press and hold rapid arrow keys through safe corridor.
mustObserve: No dropped input or per-cell freeze
Collision and ownership remain server-validated

scenarios.action: P1 and P2 drag concurrently while DM watches.
mustObserve: Remote movement observed during gestures
Existing sprites remain mounted without whole-map flash

scenarios.action: Enter DM player preview based on real player-owned token and move; then exit.
mustObserve: Player-effective sight only
Zero canonical token writes from preview
Normal DM movement still works on exit

scenarios.action: Attempt wall passage by fast drag, arrow keys, diagonal and large pointer jump.
mustObserve: No painted or persisted wall pass
No corner bypass

scenarios.action: Try closed door, then have DM open and publish; retry.
mustObserve: Closed door blocks
Published open door permits authorized path

scenarios.action: Move 2x2 token through one-cell narrow passage then wider corridor.
mustObserve: Footprint cannot clip wall or fit gap
Valid large-token movement works

scenarios.action: Move group against a wall then through clear corridor.
mustObserve: Denied group does not leave partial canonical writes
Authorized group position is atomic

scenarios.action: Move player tokens across visibility boundary.
mustObserve: Explored cells remain appropriately dim
No full-map blackout or terrain reassignment
New sight comes from authorized server frame

scenarios.action: Move in and out of LOS of hidden NPC.
mustObserve: No early NPC reveal from motion packet
Only signed sight permits reveal
Conceal on leaving sight

scenarios.action: View directional barrier from each side and attempt crossing.
mustObserve: Vision follows one-way direction
Movement remains blocked on both sides when barrier has blocksMovement=true

scenarios.action: Change static and carried torch lighting while moving.
mustObserve: Only authorized lit cells appear
Dynamic light follows carrier consistently

scenarios.action: DM publishes changed scene revision while players connected.
mustObserve: Real publication reauthorizes changed sight
Ordinary token movement does not reload map bitmap

scenarios.action: Briefly disconnect P1 then restore network.
mustObserve: Private observer locks and fails closed when necessary
Fresh viewer authorization restores safe motion

scenarios.action: DM switches active map; players follow and return.
mustObserve: No stale token/fog from previous map
All players route to correct map

scenarios.action: Under approved controlled test, revoke P1 access to designated temporary token.
mustObserve: Old content/input is revoked promptly
No stale control or unauthorized persisted movement

scenarios.action: Take P1 offline during active drag then reconnect.
mustObserve: No forged/stale commit
Final displayed position matches server authorization

scenarios.action: Edit permitted sheet/status metadata during active or recently committed movement.
mustObserve: Authorized metadata refreshes correctly
No full sprite/map remount

scenarios.action: Move placed tool and carry torch on an authorized token.
mustObserve: Tool permissions respected
Carrier light follows and never reveals unauthorized sight

scenarios.action: Measure repeatable gesture first response, RPC, observer and frame timings.
mustObserve: Separate latency phases measured with counts and p50/p95
No fabricated latency claims

scenarios.action: Perform 20 short traversals per role and 10 overlapping P1/P2 traversals; repeat under defined network emulation if available.
mustObserve: Report p50/p95, full-map blackout count, RPC counts and Realtime gaps
No absolute confidentiality or collision failures
